claims.claim: Born 30 January 1990 in Sydney, New South Wales
Height 197 cm; bats left-handed; left-arm fast bowler
ODI debut 20 Oct 2010; Test debut 1 Dec 2011; T20I debut 7 Sep 2012
ODI 4 for 27 v Sri Lanka at the Gabba in 2010
Eight wickets in a Test v South Africa in Perth; 5 for 63 in Hobart v Sri Lanka
200th Test wicket Feb 2019; 300th late 2022 v South Africa; 400th July 2025 in 100th Test in the Caribbean
Test career: 451 wickets, best 11/94, 19 five-wicket hauls
Test career: 109 matches, 2,516 runs, highest 99, bowling average 26.19, economy 3.43, 3,442.4 overs, 11,812 runs conceded
Wisden headlines dated 4 Dec 2025 (overtakes Wasim Akram), 10 Dec 2025 (Test top three), 26 Aug 2026 (No.1 Test ranking)
Wisden headline dated 6 Dec 2025: most Test runs at No.9
Wisden article dated 30 June 2026: Bangladesh spinner enters all-time top five left-arm Test five-fors
Wisden headline dated 10 Dec 2025: 'Where does Starc stand? The top 10 left-arm quicks in the ICC all-time Test rankings'
Wisden headline dated 13 April 2026: Leading Men's Cricketer in the World
2015 World Cup: 22 wickets, player of the tournament, dismissed Brendan McCullum in the first over of the final
ODI career: 132 matches, 247 wickets, best 6/28, nine five-wicket hauls, average 23.96, economy 5.27, 610 runs, highest 52
2022: quickest bowler to 200 ODI wickets, beating a 23-year record held by Saqlain Mushtaq
2023 ODI World Cup: 16 wickets; Australia won the tournament
claims.note: Profile gives 16 wickets and calls it a winning campaign for Australia; the tournament result is stated as a winning campaign, not as a title. Accepted as the same claim.

claims.claim: 2021 men's T20 World Cup: Australia won, the country's first title
T20I career: 65 matches, 79 wickets, best 4/20, average 23.81, economy 7.74, 21 innings for 98 runs
Retired from T20 internationals in September 2025 to focus on Test and ODI cricket
Big Bash League: 15 matches, 30 wickets, best 4/35, average 15.23
Nov 2017: first bowler to take a hat-trick in each innings of a Sheffield Shield match, NSW v WA
IPL 2025 auction in Jeddah: Delhi Capitals bought Starc for INR 11.75 crore as their first buy
Delhi made two significant buys in the first half of day one (Starc and KL Rahul, INR 14 crore)
Wisden 2024 Cricketers of the Year announced 15 April 2024; Starc among the five
Ashes 2023: leading wicket-taker, 23 wickets at average 27.08
Headingley third Test: five wickets in final innings; England 171 for 6 chasing 250; England still won by three wickets; Harry Brook recovered from the collapse
2025-26 Ashes: 31 wickets at 19.93, two seven-wicket hauls, player of the match in first two Tests, Compton-Miller Medal
2025-26 Ashes: Hazlewood injured and Cummins played one match, so Starc led the pace attack
Age 36 as of 27 October 2026 (from date of birth)
claims.note: Arithmetic from the confirmed date of birth.
